title: MarketTapeRecord
description: One line of a market tape: the markets service's record of a game's prices on every venue, written to data/markets/<UTC date>/<league>.jsonl while it runs with recording on, so trading strategies can be replayed against real prices. A keyframe has the game's whole state; the lines after it until the next keyframe have only what changed (quotes that moved, and quotes no longer listed). Replaying a game: start from a keyframe and apply each line in order. Prices are dollars from 0 to 1 for a contract paying $1.

t.description: When the board was built from the venues' replies.

game_id.description: The board's game id, e.g. epl-2026-10-24-chelsea-tottenham.

keyframe.description: Whether this line has the game's whole state; otherwise only what changed since the line before.

clock.description: The venue's clock, e.g. 63' or HT.

contracts.description: Keyframes only: what each contract key in the quotes is.

quotes.description: A keyframe's every quote, or the quotes that changed.

fee.description: The taker fee per contract at the ask.

gone.description: Quotes listed in the line before and not any more.
